title: Benchmark Maturity in MOF Adsorption Machine Learning
description: Reproducibility release for the accepted Digital Discovery manuscript "Benchmark Maturity in MOF Adsorption Machine Learning: When Do Conclusions Become Scientifically Reliable?" (DD-ART-06-2026-000351). The archive contains custom benchmark/post-processing software, environment/configuration files, figure/table source data, machine-readable audit outputs, and data/clean_data.zip containing the processed ARC-MOF-derived benchmark input. Raw ARC-MOF source files are not republished; the original source is https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.6908728. The numerical evaluation is in-distribution.
